messages:
tasha: heads-up — seeing a retry/backoff divergence in the ruby SDK vs go/node after the 0.3.2 push. when token refresh returns 401 we end up hammering the token endpoint and get a flurry of 502s instead of backing off.

 tasha: minimal repro (ruby):```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], retry: {max_retries: 5, base_delay: 0.2})
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'hi')
```

 tasha: relevant log fragment:```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z ERROR token_refresh: auth failed status=401
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z INFO retrying attempt=1 sleep=0.2s
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z INFO retrying attempt=2 sleep=0.2s
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z ERROR token_refresh: auth failed status=401
...
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z ERROR upstream: 502 Bad Gateway
```

 samira: which gem version exactly? we have a couple of backoff tweaks across languages.

 tasha: on 0.3.2 (published last week). test app is a tiny Sinatra runner.

 ben_k: that was my change — I ported a lighter-weight retry loop to ruby to reduce tail latency, but I forgot to carry over the `max_delay` cap and the jitter math. result: small base_delay + no cap -> tight retry spiral during auth failures. sorry folks.

 ben_k: opened quickfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/215 — adds capped exponential backoff + randomized jitter and preserves previous semantics for old installs. includes unit test for 401->200 refresh sequence.

 tasha: tried running off your branch — error rate dropped in local load test. thanks.

 ci-bot: build matrix: ruby-3.1 / ubuntu-latest — job failed: ruby-sdk-unit (flake) on rbx-2.7, rerunning. https://ci.redwood.com/builds/10922

 samira: good catch. let's make sure PR also updates CHANGELOG and call out the behavioral fix (retry cap). add an integration test that simulates token endpoint returning 401 for 2 attempts then 200.

 devex-bot: docs reminder: put retry config and env var guidance in the SDK README (REDWOOD_RETRY_MAX, REDWOOD_RETRY_BASE_DELAY, REDWOOD_RETRY_MAX_DELAY). internal guidelines: https://docs.redwood.com/dev/sdks/retries.

 ben_k: will do. plan: merge PR after CI, cut 0.3.3 with migration note (no config changes required, but default max_delay increases to avoid churn). pinging release lead.

 tasha: great. once merged I'll watch errors on the infra dashboard and report if anything else pops up. :eyes: :thumbsup:
